standard.summary: 日志载荷里带每层的完整奇异值数组，而不是只带前 5 个。
standard.effect: 默认关 = 只记每层前 5 个奇异值。打开后载荷变大（层数多时明显）。
standard.whenToUse: 想做离线分析（画完整谱、算有效秩）时打开。
standard.avoidWhen: 只是想瞄一眼健康度时别开。

standard_en.summary: Include the full per-layer singular-value array in the payload instead of only the top 5.
standard_en.effect: Default off = top-5 summary per layer. On, payloads grow (noticeable with many layers).
standard_en.whenToUse: Enable for offline analysis (full spectra, effective rank).
standard_en.avoidWhen: Leave off for a quick health glance.
